title: helianthemum × guiraoi
intro: Helianthemum × guiraoi, commonly known as Rockrose, is a hybrid plant species within the Cistaceae family, resulting from the cross between Helianthemum nummularium and Helianthemum alpestre. The Rockrose plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, potentially alleviating conditions like wounds, skin irritations, and infections. Its therapeutic actions include soothing and calming the skin, as well as providing relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum × guiraoi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
